result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback position: affiliates remain covered and the licence is transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction. It also adds preferred contractor coverage. The edits are targeted and preserve the Authorized Location, AS400, fee, and non-exclusive-use limitations. It does not reach the full preferred position because it does not make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable or limit termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach. Drafting is generally professional, though the successor-transfer formulation could be slightly more precise.
